title: Design Settings » Section Title Font
text:
## Design Settings » Section Title Font
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000097697

## Section Title Font
These settings control the font style for the title of the streaming sections, these settings apply to all the active streaming sections on the homepage.
To edit the Section Title Font navigate to:
Settings
Design Settings
Homepage Tab

## Visual Guide of the Search Box Design
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506533/original/KPiJtPNrEUeE5vQjQJLaDUVfcYHVyQmFag.png?1703889525 | alt: ]

## 1. Font Family
This setting controls the font family for the title of the active streaming sections on the homepage of the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506576/original/zzgISXs-9ucpqNRQ2ZFq2WsoRowBvw9VYg.png?1703889626 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506623/original/Tu1VYTQKuOlXHYFDD4TPsO_Mr1eMt8eCRQ.png?1703889708 | alt: ]

## 2. Font Size
This setting controls the font size for the title of the active streaming sections on the homepage of the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506663/original/AzYSztYSr1vMyayMjfHicfFBAteOjTSKbA.png?1703889790 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506673/original/TZ3012cn0MFHJaPMw_Vc4NMb6D0oddosJw.png?1703889815 | alt: ]

## 3. Font Weight
This setting controls the font weight for the title of the active streaming sections on the homepage of the website, the available options are light, normal and bold.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506681/original/t8h6Jg_WFALE0yTgHN6vgoksRoa_jzkTuw.png?1703889880 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506694/original/hDXOyyS3050rOZOiFuF2TefIKzQIYkh9wQ.png?1703889951 | alt: ]

## 4. Title Alignment
This setting controls the title alignment for the title of the active streaming sections on the homepage of the website, the default is left and the other option is center.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506744/original/o6LYOKNBtxeRQyTifkDe5Goq9H_7XBiZgw.png?1703890032 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506763/original/-LQkLfyKLBMXqXXF4lDun5anRVmBoNKryw.png?1703890084 | alt: ]

## 5. Bottom Spacing (padding)
This setting controls the padding at the bottom of the title of the active streaming sections on the homepage of the website. The options go from 0px to 100px.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506844/original/UUEnnS40JrponvLuziixxAx3ZkDDGwTzIw.png?1703890198 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506860/original/WgmVeblVnn89FYs-IqjpW0GQYVSm9EQ2mw.png?1703890272 | alt: ]

## 6. Display Divider Line
This setting will display or hide the divider line at the bottom of the title of the active streaming sections on the homepage of the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506878/original/ANN6SCkReXdWXhE1Ew0lTinAbmWyq-EcpA.png?1703890372 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12136506913/original/44NyKWPMvc9L-SM6xwoMiJ_p72U5iH9RcQ.png?1703890413 | alt: ]
